recognize_zh: 厚層血片中紅血球已溶解成淡粉紅背景，只剩白血球的深紫色核；箭頭所指處是兩個淡色、長形略彎的小結構，中央有深色染色質或色素，形狀像新月形配子體，提示惡性瘧；影像放大倍率與清晰度有限。
features: Thick smear with lysed red cells forming a pale pink granular background
Scattered leukocyte nuclei (neutrophils/lymphocytes) as dense purple bodies
Two arrowed small elongated, slightly curved parasite forms with central dark chromatin/pigment
Shapes suggest crescentic gametocytes, but detail is limited by magnification and focus
No clearly identifiable ring forms or schizonts in this field
describe_en: Thick blood film shows a background of lysed red cells with scattered leukocyte nuclei. Two small elongated, slightly curved forms with central dark chromatin and pigment are indicated by arrows, in keeping with crescentic gametocytes. Morphologic detail is limited at this magnification, and no ring forms are clearly identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes; thick films are best for detection, and species identification should be confirmed on a thin film or by antigen/PCR testing.

ddx.dx: Platelets or platelet clumps on thick film
ddx.vs: Platelets appear as small purple granular clusters without an elongated shape, organized chromatin, or pigment.
On thick films P. vivax gametocytes are larger and round rather than crescentic, and ameboid trophozoites are usually present.
Debris is irregular and refractile at different focal planes without the consistent banana shape of gametocytes.
